# Template: geometry_figure
A labeled geometry figure: a triangle (scalene, right, or isosceles) or an inscribed triangle demonstrating Thales' theorem (a right angle inscribed in a semicircle), with vertex/side/angle labels, angle-mark arcs or a right-angle square, and congruent-side tick marks. Choose this scene for ANY request about a triangle, right triangle, isosceles triangle, the Pythagorean theorem's setup figure, congruent triangles/sides, angle marking, or Thales' / the inscribed-angle theorem.
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "kind": {
   "type": "string",
   "enum": [
    "triangle",
    "right_triangle",
    "isosceles",
    "circle_theorem"
   ],
   "description": "Default \"triangle\" (a generic scalene triangle). circle_theorem draws Thales' theorem: a triangle inscribed on a circle's diameter."
  },
  "vertex_labels": {
   "type": "array",
   "items": {
    "type": "string"
   },
   "description": "Names for the 3 vertices, default [A, B, C]."
  },
  "side_labels": {
   "type": "array",
   "items": {
    "type": "string"
   },
   "description": "Labels for the 3 sides, side_labels[i] on the side OPPOSITE vertex i."
  },
  "angle_labels": {
   "type": "array",
   "items": {},
   "description": "Labels (strings or numbers, e.g. \"α\" or 90) for marked angles, angle_labels[i] at vertex i."
  },
  "mark_angles": {
   "type": "array",
   "items": {
    "type": "integer",
    "enum": [
     0,
     1,
     2
    ]
   },
   "description": "Which vertices get an angle-mark arc."
  },
  "congruent_sides": {
   "type": "array",
   "items": {
    "type": "array",
    "items": {
     "type": "integer",
     "enum": [
      0,
      1,
      2
     ]
    },
    "minItems": 2,
    "maxItems": 2
   },
   "description": "Pairs of side indices to mark as congruent with matching tick counts, e.g. [[0,1]]."
  },
  "right_angle_at": {
   "type": "integer",
   "enum": [
    0,
    1,
    2
   ],
   "description": "Which vertex gets the right-angle square mark instead of an arc. Defaults to 0 for right_triangle and circle_theorem."
  },
  "hypotenuse_label": {
   "type": "string",
   "description": "Label for the side opposite right_angle_at (the hypotenuse); takes priority over side_labels for that side."
  }
 }
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- side_<i>: the side opposite vertex i, with its label (from side_labels[i] or hypotenuse_label) when given
- vertex_label_<i>: vertex i's name
- angle_<i>: the angle mark at vertex i (arc, or a square if it is right_angle_at), present for vertices in mark_angles or right_angle_at
- angle_label_<i>: its numeric/letter label, present when angle_labels[i] is given
- ticks_<i>: congruence tick marks on side i, present for sides named in congruent_sides
- circle: the circumscribing circle, present only for kind circle_theorem
Examples:
Request: "Prove Thales' theorem: an angle inscribed in a semicircle is a right angle." → params: {"kind":"circle_theorem","vertex_labels":["C","A","B"],"angle_labels":["90°"]}

In YAML: `template: geometry_figure` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
